description: This file defines the ConfigFactoryInterface interface for a configuration object factory in Drupal, including method signatures for retrieving, resetting, renaming, and managing configuration objects.

classes.name: ConfigFactoryInterface
classes.description: Interface for a configuration object factory in Drupal, defining methods for managing configuration objects.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns an immutable configuration object for a given name.

methods.name: getEditable
methods.description: Returns a mutable configuration object for a given name.

methods.name: loadMultiple
methods.description: Returns a list of configuration objects for the given names.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames a configuration object using the storage.

methods.name: getCacheKeys
methods.description: Returns cache keys associated with the state of the config factory.

methods.name: clearStaticCache
methods.description: Clears the static cache of the config factory.

methods.name: listAll
methods.description: Gets configuration object names starting with a given prefix.
